summary: Audited EuroComply SaaS main and open PR #837 for build status, security risks, broken routes, configuration drift, billing/demo exposure, cron limits, and recent changes. PR #837 was a safe non-runtime local validation hardening change with green CI/security checks, so it was merged. Production remains no-go until GitHub Actions run on the new main merge/log commits.
actions_taken: Validated PR #837 changed only local/bootstrap validation scripts and documentation plus a release contract comment; no runtime product, Supabase, Stripe, Clerk, RLS, auth, or database changes were included.

Validated PR #837 head had CI, Security CI, Full Security Suite, CodeQL, Semgrep, Gitleaks, Dependency Review, P0 Runtime Evidence, P0 Runtime Gap Report, P0 Progress, Actionlint, Secret Scanning, and Upload Security CI passing.
Merged PR #837 into main as a safe non-breaking correction to make local/Codespaces validation deterministic and prevent interactive Playwright prompts.
Validated the new main merge commit had no GitHub Actions workflow runs immediately after merge, so production remains no-go until post-merge CI/security runs exist.
Validated vercel.json still has exactly one cron entry for /api/internal/daily-maintenance.
Validated /api/internal/daily-maintenance still requires internal cron authorization and uses no-store downstream POST calls.
Validated /api/ready still requires HEALTHCHECK_TOKEN bearer validation and returns no-store readiness output.
Validated /api/prelaunch remains bounded, rate-limited, consent-gated, honeypot-aware, and no-store.
Recorded this audit in append-only agent_log.d because rewriting the full aggregate agent_log.json risks dropping historical entries.
